title: Show, Don't Tell Explained with Examples
skills: distinguish showing from telling in prose
replace general statements with concrete details
use action, dialogue, and sensory description
revise narrative writing for stronger imagery and reader engagement
alignment_note: Explains the 'show, don't tell' technique with examples that demonstrate how concrete detail, action, dialogue, and sensory language can make writing more vivid. Supports descriptive writing, characterization, narrative craft, and revision across high school English and creative writing courses.
